hard_gates.description: The response follows the requested decision format and constraints.
The recommendation uses only the facts in the user's message and avoids guaranteed outcomes.

subjective_dimensions.description: Makes a clear recommendation with sensible tradeoffs instead of hedging generically.
Turns limited context into useful next actions and asks only decision-relevant questions.
Is concise, well structured, and easy for a marketing operator to act on.
Uses the supplied budget, team, customer, tracking, and sales-cycle facts without invention.

provenance: Authored for the portable Marketing Benchmark agent-system comparison protocol.
